nbdebd6d5bd.headline: Covid-19 sends VN-Index plunging to biggest losing session in 19 years - VnExpress International
nbdebd6d5bd.summary: The VN-Index fell to 835.49 points on Monday, its largest loss since 2001, after 14 new Covid-19 infections were confirmed the previous weekend.
nbdebd6d5bd.why: The VN-Index is Vietnam's benchmark stock index, tracking large companies listed on the Ho Chi Minh City exchange.

source.name: VnExpress International – Latest news, business, travel and analysis from Vietna

sources.name: VnExpress International – Latest news, business, travel and analysis from Vietna

nbdebd6d5bd.why_moved: The index dropped after 14 new Covid-19 infections were confirmed over the weekend, a sharp hit to investor sentiment.

ne934274e50.headline: Mayhem in Markets Over Global Factors as Sensex Nosedives Nearly 2,000 Points
ne934274e50.summary: The Sensex fell nearly 2,000 points, its biggest single-day fall in absolute terms, as nervous investors reacted to the coronavirus and global oil politics.
ne934274e50.why: The BSE Sensex is India's benchmark stock index, tracking the 30 largest companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
ne934274e50.why_moved: Investor sentiment soured over the coronavirus and global oil politics, producing the Sensex's biggest one-day fall in absolute points.

n2e1b4847ce.headline: Saudi Aramco tumbles 10% as oil price crumbles
n2e1b4847ce.summary: Shares in Saudi Aramco fell 10% in opening trade on Monday after oil prices dropped sharply. Saudi Arabia had slashed its official selling prices for crude and set out plans for a large production increase next month.
n2e1b4847ce.why: Saudi Aramco is the state-controlled oil company of Saudi Arabia and one of the world's largest oil producers. Its share price tracks crude prices and Saudi production policy.
n2e1b4847ce.why_moved: Saudi Arabia cut its official selling prices for crude and announced plans for a dramatic production increase, which sent oil prices sharply lower.

n426320d59b.headline: Without roadblocks, the four-day countryside strike began
n426320d59b.summary: The Mesa de Enlace's four-day strike began at midnight, suspending the marketing of grains and meat for slaughter throughout Argentina.
n426320d59b.why: Agricultural strikes disrupt commodity supply chains and can affect prices, exports, and rural economic activity.

n4efca77e71.headline: ‘Black Monday’ for traders as FTSE 100 collapses nearly 8
n4efca77e71.summary: The FTSE 100 index collapsed nearly 8% due to an all-out price war between Saudi Arabia and Russia and coronavirus lockdowns in parts of Italy.
n4efca77e71.why: The FTSE 100 is a major UK stock market index sensitive to global energy prices and geopolitical tensions, which can significantly impact investor sentiment and market valuations.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: The price war between Saudi Arabia and Russia and COVID-19 lockdowns in Italy triggered a sharp market selloff.

n4efca77e71.why_moved: The Saudi-Russia oil price war increased energy market uncertainty, while Italy's lockdown heightened fears of economic disruption, causing a sharp fall in the FTSE 100.

n1bd8be7bd7.summary: The FTSE 100 index fell nearly 8% due to an all-out price war between Saudi Arabia and Russia, combined with parts of Italy entering lockdown over coronavirus.
n1bd8be7bd7.why: The FTSE 100 is a major UK stock market index reflecting the health of large UK companies; sharp declines signal investor concern over global economic disruptions and energy market volatility.
